Thanks Mateo — quick checklist from the marketplace/listing side so we can scope work before the PDM call:

1) Legal & Commercial
- Draft SOW/partner agreement (CloudPulse to confirm terms). If a private offer required, we’ll coordinate pricing grid and approval timeline.

2) Technical & Security
- Short security questionnaire (SOC 2 status, data residency, encryption in transit at rest).
- Minimal listing artifacts: product description (200–300 words), three screenshots, an integration diagram.

3) Ops & Go-to-Market
- GTM pointer: co-marketing collateral (co-branded one-pager) and an enablement recording.
- PSM ask: identify an initial customer pilot contact and expected success criteria (latency, cost delta).

If Jenna confirms PDM availability, let’s lock a handshake for Wed 11/11 11:00 PT (30m) — I can run the intake items in parallel. Sophie/Tom, if you prefer Thu 11/12 we can do that too.

I’ll also open a HubSpot intake record and a shared Drive folder for artifacts (I’ll paste the links on the call).

—Kimberly
